name: madnesswright
description: Mod MADNESS: Project Nexus with an AI agent the official way: mod folders, info.txt and MadCards on the releasebeta branch, SceneTools levels, stages and campaigns, ModTools weapons, armor and characters, and Harmony code loaded by the game itself. A stdlib Python helper finds the install and branch, backs up saves, lints mods and scenes against the game's own rules, deploys mods and reads the mod log. Evergreen.
